_comment: Allowlist for tools/ci/check_override_signatures.py. Each entry silences one (category, typepath, proc) triple. NEVER baseline a real signature-drift bug - fix the override instead. Regenerate with --write-baseline ONLY after triaging new findings.

known_real_bugs_not_baselined.why: slot 2 of /atom/movable/screen/Initialize is datum/hud/hud_owner; the reticle is built as new(null, src) so ..() hands a CONSOLE to set_new_hud(), leaving screen.hud pointing at an /obj/machinery/computer. get_mob() then reads .mymob off a machine.

upstream /datum/vote/proc/toggle_votable() takes ZERO args and vote.dm:409 calls selected.toggle_votable(); the fork declares (mob/toggler), so toggler is always null and the proc CRASHes on every admin toggle.

upstream declares can_be_initiated(forced = FALSE) and vote.dm:210 calls it with one arg; the fork declares (mob/by_who, forced) so 'forced' is always null. It also returns TRUE instead of VOTE_AVAILABLE, and the caller tests != VOTE_AVAILABLE, so the transfer vote can never be initiated.
same finding as above, seen through the name-drift lens (slot 1 forced -> by_who).

entries.reason: pre-existing; override declares more params than the ROOT declaration (usually a dead leftover param such as times_fired).
